title: Infinite counterexamples to Connes's rigidity conjecture
abstract: Constructs one finitely generated property-(T) ICC group and an infinite family of finitely generated property-(T) ICC groups that are pairwise nonisomorphic and are each nonisomorphic to the first group, while all of their tracial group von Neumann algebras are normally star-isomorphic. This unconditional infinite-family result is independent of the pooled conditional two-group Connes-rigidity formalization.

informal.ConnesRigidity.infiniteConnesRigidity: Registry-friendly alias of the exact canonical infinite-family Connes-rigidity counterexample theorem below.
informal.ConnesRigidity.exists_infinite_pairwise_: There exist a finitely generated property-(T) ICC group and an infinite sequence of finitely generated property-(T) ICC groups such that all their tracial group von Neumann algebras are normally star-isomorphic, although the sequence is pairwise nonisomorphic and none of its groups is isomorphic to the distinguished group.
